Diagnosis
Based on the presence of the Westrom triad of symptomatology plus one of the minor criteria Confirmation by demonstration of causative organism(s) on microscopy, culture and sensitivity testing
Differential Diagnoses
- Acute appendicitis
- Ovarian cyst accident
- Endometriosis
- Urinary tract infections
- Renal disorders (e.g. nephrolithiasis)
- Pelvic adhesions
- Lower lobe pneumonia
- Ectopic gestation
